mapper.select: SELECT scm03_expect_program_id AS expect_program_id , scm03_sr_id AS sr_id , scm03_program_id AS program_id , f_cdnm('ProgramType', scm30_program_type, 1, f_sysdate()) AS program_type_nm , scm30_program_cd AS program_cd , scm30_program_nm AS program_nm FROM scm03_expect_program LEFT OUTER JOIN scm30_program ON scm03_program_id = scm30_program_id WHERE scm03_sr_id = #{srId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm03_expect_program (scm03_expect_program_id, scm03_sr_id, scm03_program_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{srId}, #{programId})
